owned_invariants: A task is edges, a list of pairs of exact integers, and labels, one exact integer 0 or 1 per edge, with at most 20 edges. Anything else is an error with the reason.
A flip list is a list of exact integers, each the index of an edge; it is read as a set. A missing list, an entry that is not an exact integer and an index out of range each have their own reason.
A fundamental cycle is odd when the labels on it, after the listed flips, sum to an odd number. An edge on no cycle never makes one odd.
least_repair is the size of the smallest set of edges whose flips leave no fundamental cycle odd, found by visiting every set of edges.
A reply is accepted exactly when its flips leave no cycle odd and their number is the least repair. Its measure is the number of odd cycles left.
The residual is the number of flips, the numbers of the cycles still odd, and whether none is odd. It never names an edge to flip, and it does not say what the least number of flips is.
boundaries: The search visits 2 to the power of the edge count sets, about a million at the limit of 20. The limit is what keeps a task affordable.
Only the fundamental cycles of graph.rs's forest are examined; every cycle of the graph is a sum of those.
The residual key minimal_known is the old protocol's name. It reports that no cycle is odd, not that the repair is least.

score.level_basis: Typed refusals on every failure path, closed requests, exact unbounded integers and rationals, no float, no unwrap or expect.
